# Task 46 fix 2: Off outline too thin at 30px

Same worktree/branch. AGENTS.md rules. Never run next start/dev. Do not push.

`.muse-ref/off-dark.png`: in dark theme the Off cloud (engraving shown; watercolor and ink same) has the right light colour and opacity .58, but its stroke is ~1.1 units of a 100-unit viewBox rendered at ~30px, i.e. about 0.33 CSS px, so it is almost invisible. Light theme Off is also very faint.

Fix in app/icons-rain.tsx (Off state only, all three skins): stroke width about 3.4 units (≈1px on screen) with a dash scaled to match (about "7 5.5" for engraving/watercolor; ink keep its rounder dash scaled the same way), so Off reads as a clear but faint dashed cloud in both themes, comparable to the old icon's Off. Keep colours/opacities otherwise. Nothing else changes. Update any source-pinning test if needed.

Run npm test, typecheck, build, check:size. One commit. Do not push.
